case_number: 2025 INSC 104; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (C) No.21778 of 2024)
summary: Stamp duty refund claim post-cancellation deed; executed pre-amendment (17.03.2015), registered post-amendment (28.04.2015); Maharashtra Stamp Act, s.48(1) amendment reduced two-year limitation to six months; registration date vs execution date as trigger; accrued right to refund based on execution date; procedural limitation change inapplicable to vested cause of action; M.P. Steel Corporation precedent; registration irrelevant to refund trigger; High Court error in applying amended limitation; refund claim within original two-year window; impugned judgment set aside; refund claim referred to CCRA for fresh decision within unamended framework.
legal_provisions_cited: M.P. Steel Corporation v. Commissioner of Central Excise (2015)7 SCC 58
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; matter referred to CCRA for consideration under unamended two-year limitation provision.
